messages:
incident-bot: Pager — P0: spike in 5xxs and timeouts on /v1/prompt-route (experimental endpoint). 60% of requests failing for experi-route. Alerting SLO breach. Tags: region=us-east, route=experi-route :rotating_light:

maya (oncall): on it. pulling logs and dashboard now. any customer reports?

john-cs: getting 3 inbound tickets from a single enterprise customer, they report timeouts ~10:35 PDT. no public status page update yet.

maya (oncall): ok thanks @john-cs. look like canary rollout for `experi-route` started ~10:28. can we flip the flag while we investigate?

sandeep: if it's the new endpoint backend it's safest to cut traffic. i can toggle the ff. which key?

maya (oncall): flag is `rollout.experiments.prompt_route_v2`. plan: immediate cutoff to 0% traffic -> confirm rollback to stable. will notify product and CS.

eli (next-oncall): FYI i'm up next, will take over post-mitigation.

maya (oncall): executing kill switch now.

sandeep: running command:```bash
curl -X POST "https://ff.redwood.internal/api/v1/flags/rollout.experiments.prompt_route_v2/set" -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN" -d '{"percent":0}'
```
response: `{"status":"ok","percent":0}`

maya (oncall): observed immediate drop in error rate on the frontend within 30s. tailing logs to ensure no residual errors. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Deploy event: rollback of canary `experi-route` -> `stable-route` triggered by maya at 10:37. CI job 3842 started, deployment to us-east in progress.

maya (oncall): checking metrics: 5xx rate back to baseline in us-east. latency normalizing. starting impact assessment.

john-cs: confirming with customer that things look better on their side. they said responses resumed. will hold for 10m then update them.

amy (product): thanks — please capture what caused the failure and whether the model variant or routing logic is at fault. we need a postmortem with remediation (prefetching kv cache?).

maya (oncall): quick notes for handoff: mitigation = feature flag set to 0% + canary rollback. customer impact = partial for select enterprise customers (time window ~10:28-10:37), estimated affected requests ~12k, severity P1->mitigated. created incident ticket: INC-2027.

eli (next-oncall): taking over. i'll keep monitoring for 30m and run the degraded-route smoke tests. tagging SRE and eng-runtime to investigate root cause.

sandeep: i'll capture ff toggle logs and the deploy job output and attach to INC-2027. also saving config snapshot:```json
{"route_config":"experi-route","model_variant":"v2-alpha","batch_config":"adaptive"}
```

maya (oncall): good. action items: eng-runtime to reproduce on staging, product to decide on canary gating changes, CS follow up with impacted customers, infra to add an automated guard if a canary causes >30% error within 5m.

eli (next-oncall): OK i'm posting a short status update to status.redwood.ai now, and then handing to oncall rotation note. everyone add any followups to INC-2027. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Status page updated: "Degraded: Resolved" at 10:45 PDT by eli.

maya (oncall): closing active page. feel free to ping if anything pops back up. nice quick work everyone. :party:
__archive_note: generated thread for dataset — contains mitigation, kill-switch toggle, deploy rollback, CS coordination, and on-call handoff
